dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: The boss of Djembe Studios, at your service. I sell some old instruments.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: Quite a few tourists who watch musical performances at Colomche Plaza come here to buy some — for my part, I always get them to try things out first, then come back the next day.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: Many youngsters get caught up in the heat of the moment, buy an instrument, then wind up never playing it.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: All the ones sold here hold some sentimental value to me, so I'd rather they not lie abandoned in someone's house.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: As such, I prefer to give customers a chance to cool down and come back later. There's time aplenty, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: This store isn't going anywhere, and there's nothing wrong with just enjoying music.
